summary: Complete frontend testing of DiaGyn page UI/UX redesign with dark theme (#0D0D0D) and toggle-based doctor/clinic selection. All core features verified: dark theme, blue accent color (#3B82F6), toggle pill buttons for doctor and clinic selection, detail cards with About/Qualifications/Specialties sections, step progress indicators with blue highlights, calendar with dark background and blue header, time slots with dark cards and blue selected state.

critical_code_review_comments: DiaGyn page implementation is clean with proper dark theme styling
Toggle pills use consistent blue accent (#3B82F6) matching design spec
Doctor/Clinic detail cards expand properly with animation
data-testid attributes present on all interactive elements for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: DiaGyn page UI redesign verified with dark theme (#0D0D0D background), toggle-based selection for doctors and clinics, detail cards with About/Qualifications/Specialties sections, calendar with blue header and selection, time slots with dark cards and blue selected state. All flows working: Guest access → Doctor selection → Clinic selection → Date/Time selection. Note: IntroScreen requires clicking 'Guest' button first, and notification popup may appear which can be dismissed with 'Later' button.

design_verification.text_colors: White for primary, gray-400/500 for secondary
